0.content: An artifact text tells how a chronicler from the sea of stars, whose body slept far away while her mind travelled, was woken from ages of meditation by the brilliance of Teyvat and its primeval dragon. She told its ruler she had seen the Abyss tear through star clusters and silence all songs, and asked him to leave his doomed world with her. He thanked her but refused: to him his people were the meaning of the universe, his bones would shield the realm, and he would lead them to the stars. When she returned, he had vanished "like drifting smoke", the land was bound by four shackles, white light had been split into seven elements, and the Winged One ruled the three moons. She then entered Hyperborea in a borrowed body.

1.content: According to Nicole, the moons were born of Nibelung's will. The Heavenly Principles let them stay because they kept the planet working. When he returned, the sisters split: one wanted to follow the one who first hung them in the sky, and another feared that taking sides would ruin the world, especially as he now carried the Abyss. He discovered their disloyalty, imprisoned all three and made the moons weapons that terrified all living things. The Heavenly Principles shattered two moons and cast the Frost Moon beyond the sky.

2.content: In 7.0 Aksinya told the Traveler that Hyperborea had tried to forge the Belyi Tsar from the Primordial Cryo Dragon's flesh to give him "authority equal to The One". The One was Nibelung: a will born alongside Teyvat, the master of the Light Realm's power, and King of all Dragon Lords. She said the place of Primordial Human, or Narayana, has been vacant since his destruction. The experiment ran out of control, froze Snezhnaya and drew down a Celestial Nail.

key: Lord of Darkness Who Returned From the Sea of Stars
3.comment: Nibelung: The dragons who waited (Project Moongazer)
3.content: On the Frost Moon, dragon researchers kept faith with their absent king. The pioneer Ibni-Belum caught a mysterious deep-space signal and believed it was Nibelung's. He built a transceiver station to catch it again, but it never returned and his students later converted the station for lunar monitoring. Another, later base was built "from the will" of the "Lord of Darkness Who Returned From the Sea of Stars": it drew on the moon's core to turn the moon into a space-based weapon, and the Traveler took this to mean the returned Nibelung.

4.content: Apep told Nahida that the dragons once believed only forbidden knowledge could defeat the Heavenly Principles, and that the Dragon King brought back the power of darkness and led them against the outsiders' order. The victors won the right to shape the world. After his death Apep kept gathering forbidden knowledge until a Celestial Nail turned her forests to desert. Some dragons have since befriended humans and forgotten, but she says his scales and will still shine in her heart, and she will follow them to the end.
